name: Chatan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Chatan town emblem in red: a winged device above a ring enclosing a small ring.
history: Municipal flag of Chatan, a town in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 April 1973.

features.role: Chatan town emblem — a winged device above a ring enclosing a small ring
